description: Update the name of a Submittal Response for the specified Project

id.description: Unique identifier of this submittal response option, returned as a string. Use as the {id} path parameter to update the response via PATCH /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/su...

name.description: Display label shown for this response in the submittal workflow (for example "Approved" or "Rejected"). For default responses this is the localized label; for custom responses it is the user-define...

considered.description: Underlying disposition category the response maps to, which drives submittal workflow behavior. Fixed when the response is created and cannot be changed.

403.description: User does not have permission to update Submittal Responses

name.description: New display name for the submittal response. Required. Maximum 255 characters.
